scope: Every mcs/ops/*.py except parent-owned mcs_update.py, mcs_restore.py and c1_records.py. Prior operations/deployment dossier remains separate.
method: Complete source AST and caller/resource inventory, focused manual trust-boundary inspection, broad synthetic operations suites, and concrete failed-before/passed-after regressions. No speculative broad refactors.

findings.evidence: Serialization and OSError/KeyboardInterrupt fsync failures previously poisoned exclusive final destination; now no output/temp remains, rerun succeeds and prior result is not overwritten.
Four non-object target JSON shapes previously raised AttributeError; now return 1; deep JSON also returns 1 via same failure contract.

Infinite as_of previously escaped OverflowError. Large integer vs float mismatch 2**53+1 vs float(2**53) was falsely equal; 10**1000 vs 1.0 overflowed. Fixed corrupt classification and exact large-number differences; small rounding tolerance retained.
Synthetic arbitrary string/list/dict type contents were exposed as count-only aggregate keys; known DETECTORS types or unknown now only emitted, total counts preserved.

Claimed source continued returning bytes until fixture emergency stop. Now initial length+1 then 1-byte growth probe rejects refstat_hash_mismatch; pending and prior approved bytes restored, no temp survives.

validation.broad: 1897 tests/ops cases passed excluding parent-owned test_mcs_update.py/test_mcs_restore.py/test_c1_records.py collections; collected before added growth and large-integer cases.
validation.refresh: 75 result/repair/CLI/lifecycle checks; 95 refreshed promotion/operations/refstats/feedback/aggregate/result checks; 36 final numeric/refstats/as_of checks and 8 final CLI/publication checks passed. Unchanged successes reused; parent integrated whole suite remains final authority.

limitations: No actual provisioning, key material, backup to shared storage, restore of real data, external receiver delivery, gateway/native service mutation or push/commit.
Parent performs final shared-doc regeneration and full integrated checks after all source changes; this dossier records assigned source coverage and local synthetic evidence.
